Subject: POC wrap: performance snapshot + two-minute quote / quick 10-min sync

Hi Claire / Samir,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week pilot — really appreciate how quickly your data engineering team moved. We finished the final run last night and I wanted to share a concise snapshot of the results and a small ask from marketing if you’re open.

Quick metrics (Pilot period: 3/20–4/2):
- Average request latency dropped from 420ms -> 230ms (45% reduction) for the 2k token median path.
- Peak throughput improved 3.2x under the same VM profile (sustained 140 rps vs 44 rps previously).
- Effective per-request cost decreased ~62% after enabling KV caching + dynamic batching.
- Safety/QA: false-positive rate on the classification eval set remained stable at 1.1%.

What we’d love (two small asks):
1) A two-line quote/one-sentence soundbite we can include in a short case blurb (example in the attached guidance file). Something like: “Redwood cut our inference latency in half and reduced token cost dramatically, which unlocked faster responses in production.” — no pressure, totally optional.
2) A quick 10–15 minute sync next week to confirm attribution wording and one line on business impact (ops time saved / faster retailer checkout flow).

Attachments: BrightLane_POC_metrics_20270403.pdf (metrics + charts), testimonial_guidance_short.md (example phrasing and attribution options).

Proposed times (PST): Mon 4/5 10:00–10:15, Tue 4/6 14:00–14:15, Wed 4/7 09:30–09:45. If none of those work, tell me what’s best.

Thanks — if you’re happy, I’ll loop in Marissa from our customer marketing team to coordinate the short quote and confirm the calendar.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Customer Growth
Redwood Inference
